Hi Ellen / Audit Ops team,

Quick context: Redwood is starting a focused effort to align our ISO 27001 migration artifacts with the FedRAMP evidence scope so we can avoid duplicate collection during the upcoming FedRAMP engagement. I've attached a draft controls mapping and a preliminary proposal for a sample window we think will work for both audits.

Two asks to help us plan:
1) Can you confirm Auditor preference for sample windows (continuous rolling vs fixed snapshot)? Our initial thought is to propose a 3-day fixed window (Sept 29–Oct 1) for log and config snapshots.
2) For evidence lookback, do you expect the 12-month trailing period or a 6/12 split for specific control families?

I've also included a short inventory (redwood-evidence-inventory.csv) that lists likely artifacts and tentative owners. If you can indicate which artifacts are acceptable (e.g., Kibana exported logs vs DB query extracts, KMS attestations, vendor SOC2 PDFs), that will speed alignment.

Proposed next steps: internal dry-run on Sept 25, then formal sample window Sept 29–Oct 1. If those dates conflict with auditor availability we can shift.

Kimberly — thanks for the summary and the attachments. Couple quick clarifications before we lock dates:

• Sample window: our lead auditor prefers a fixed snapshot window for evidence extraction (makes tracing reproducible). The proposed Sept 29–Oct 1 range is acceptable from our side, pending internal resource confirmation.
• Lookback period: generally 12 months for operational controls (logs, change history), but for configuration baselines we sometimes accept a 90-day baseline plus attestations for older records.
• Artifacts: Kibana exports are fine provided you include the query and index/version metadata. For KMS, a console screenshot with key metadata plus the KMS rotation policy is usually acceptable; an HSM attestation is even better if you can supply it.

Please: provide a control-owner roster and point-of-contact for each artifact by Sept 24 EOD so we can route requests. Also include any vendor SOC2 reports (current) in advance.

We reviewed the docsend link you shared and left inline notes under controls 6.1 and 9.3.

—Ellen
Ellen May
Director, Audit & Risk — CityBank
